name: Keilah
line: Keilah was a walled city in the lowland of Judah that David saved from the Philistines, then left when its people might hand him over to Saul.

moments.title: David saves Keilah
moments.text: The Philistines were attacking Keilah and looting its threshing floors. The LORD told David to go, and David and his men struck the Philistines with a mighty blow and saved the people of Keilah.

moments.title: Saul plans to trap David
moments.text: Saul heard that David was in Keilah and said God had delivered him, since David was in a town with gates and bars. Saul called his troops to go to war and besiege David and his men.

moments.title: The LORD warns David
moments.text: David asked the LORD if Saul would come and if the citizens of Keilah would give him up. The LORD said they would.

moments.title: David leaves Keilah
moments.text: David and his men, about six hundred strong, left Keilah and kept moving from place to place. When Saul heard David had escaped, he decided not to go.
